Region Østdanmarks Sundhedsfaglige Råd for Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygdomme (Region Eastern Denmark's Professional Health Council for Gastrointestinal and Liver Diseases) is a professional coordination body that oversees clinical efforts and quality development for gastrointestinal and liver diseases within Region Østdanmark [^src1]. 

The council's role in the Danish healthcare system is highlighted in the 2024–2025 annual report from the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) database (DANIBD) [^src1]. In the report, the council is cited as the originating source for qualitative comments and feedback provided by Abdominalcenter K at Bispebjerg Hospital [^src1]. This feedback is part of a comprehensive regional data validation process that includes critical data analysis, internal audits, and the adjustment of quality indicator calculations, such as those tracking DEXA scanning and re-operation rates [^src1]. 

Through its coordination efforts, the council exemplifies the structured collaboration between national registries, regional health authorities like Region Hovedstaden, and local hospital departments [^src1]. By channeling professional feedback into the DANIBD reporting process, the council helps ensure that the national IBD quality program functions as a dynamic, reflective tool for continuous clinical improvement rather than a passive database [^src1].
